Can India compete with China's manufacturing dominance? Can manufacturing still generate mass employment in an age of automation? Why does Asia favour large business conglomerates over specialised firms? Is India undercounting its diaspora-driven tourism economy? And how realistic are Pakistan's long-term economic ambitions? In this episode of , ThePrint Consulting Editor (Economics) Dr Bidisha Bhattacharya answers these questions, with Manya Gupta.
